svg.text: DSC03049: one edit, drawn as a shader pipeline
the ARW is the input texture, the XMP is the program, the ACR holds the textures an AI model baked, and the JPG is the framebuffer
7168×5120 sensor strip, 41.6 MB, in a SubIFD
AI object selection + brush = what to erase
3 generated variations stored as RGB patches
the chosen one pasted at pm_target (shown)
XMP parameters: plain numbers, re-run on every render
ACR textures: AI output, stored as rasters so the result does not drift
parametric masks: XMP only, no raster
stacked in XMP order; Adobe does not document the engine's internal pass order
